scope: Read-only verification of the active GTK2 profile and installed DomainOS GTK2 theme tree

observations.comparison: The only gtkrc difference is the generated BEGIN/END KDE GTK2 palette include pointing into this user's XDG data. A recursive comparison of the remaining GTK2 theme files reported no differences. This preserves dynamic KDE color roles; it is not a static-color substitution.

limits: This confirms the selected profile and installed bytes, not the rendered pixels of every already-running GTK2 application.
R654 recorded a broadcast to 177 windows, but did not correlate delivery or repaint to each application window.
No GTK2 process was restarted, no window was focused, and no theme or desktop setting was changed in this observation.
